A home bakery with a personal touch

Baker's Table is a home-based custom cake business in Johar Town, Lahore. Every cake is customized for the occasion — tell us what you're celebrating and the cake is designed around it.

Alongside custom orders, Baker's Table also runs baking classes in Johar Town, so you can learn to bake and decorate cakes yourself.
